title: FOUNDRY / OMNITOOLS
version_scope: v3 is the third Omnitools instrument revision, recorded as 0.3. Child tools retain independent versions.
claim: Hold one exact input, transform it in a native tool, inspect the whole result, promote that result to the next source and undo the turn exactly. The canonical Triangle Bench supports generic measured constraints and decisions; all views retain their native semantics in one bounded stage.

mutation: Complete v3 with full native result hooks, source promotion/undo/return, strict conversion failure boundaries, compact native stages and corrected resize/provenance/browser assertions.
known_limits: pii-scan regex detectors are heuristics: real-name is keyword-anchored and low confidence; entropy sweep trades recall for noise (default 4.5 bits/char, pure-hex skipped).
pii-scan history scan reports patch positions (hist:<sha>:<path>:<line>); deleted-line numbers refer to the pre-image file.

pii-scan baseline acknowledges findings per fingerprint (detector:file:sha256(value)[0:16]) — line numbers and commit shas are excluded so entries survive line moves and new commits, but the same secret in a different file is a different entry; baselined findings are always reported and only excluded from --fail-on.

pii-scan --verify probes only github-token, npm-token and stripe-key (read-only provider GETs); everything else stays verified:'unchecked', and a provider 5xx or offline run also degrades to 'unchecked' rather than guessing.
html-munge is regex-based, not a DOM: malformed markup or deeply nested tables may extract imperfectly.
re-reader aligns segments by index only; unequal block counts are displayed as missing, not silently padded.
re-reader word counts come from Intl.Segmenter (ICU dictionary segmentation) where the engine has it; without it, the whitespace fallback mis-segments Chinese and the UI says so in the hint.
Flesch readability in text-lens is an approximation (English syllable heuristic) and meaningless for Tamil/Chinese input.
Browser tools are client-side only and never transmit pasted content.
Decision comparison only uses entered alternatives, criteria and uncertainty. Numerical fit does not establish physical safety or real-world suitability.
Physical cylinder / connector / applicator lineage is retained as design context; this browser release does not implement or validate physical actuation.
Actual user use/value remains unobserved. Passing software checks does not establish lived usefulness.
Flattening changes structural representation; collisions, duplicate columns, ragged rows and malformed JSON/CSV fail closed. Exact source undo restores input instead of inferring it from flat output.
Local source history retains up to 12 turns, bounded by aggregate text size. Carrier RETURN exports exact retained source and turns; no world effect or real adoption is inferred.
